info.title: BestoDine Internal API (inventory)
info.description: Best-effort static inventory of the staff/customer API, generated by scripts/generate-openapi.js from routes/*.js and app.js. Auth, feature gates and validators are x- extensions; request bodies list the fields express-validator chains declare (other fields may be accepted); responses are not inventoried. Not a stable contract. The public API is documented in public-v1.json.
